staffShares.title: Share Links
staffShares.subtitle: Inspect shared links across normal drive, saves, and channels, and revoke active links.
staffShares.detailSubtitle: Link metadata, linked resources, counters, and revocation record.
staffShares.ownerDeactivatedNote: Deactivated by the link owner (no staff revocation actor or reason recorded).
staffShares.noItems: No linked items recorded for this share.
staffShares.revokeDescription: Revoking disables this link immediately, blocking new share browsing, saving, and view or install tracking through it. Existing saved copies and historical counts are preserved.

staffChannels.title: Channels
staffChannels.subtitle: Inspect channels, subscriber counts, content counts, and moderation state.
staffChannels.detailSubtitle: Channel metadata, owner, media assets, content links, and moderation controls.
staffChannels.name: Channel name
staffChannels.noModerationDecision: No moderation decision has been recorded for this channel yet.
staffChannels.suspendDescription: Suspending hides the channel from discovery and subscribed lists and blocks direct browsing, share access, new subscriptions, saves, new playback/download URLs, and app-issued uploads. Existing files and subscriptions stay attached. Previously issued URLs and upload credentials may remain valid until expiry.
staffChannels.restoreDescription: Restoring sets moderation status back to active and reopens discovery, direct browsing, share access, subscriptions, saves, playback/download URL issuance, and uploads subject to normal channel rules.

staffFiles.title: Files
staffFiles.subtitle: Inspect original files, upload and moderation states, and per-file analytics.
staffFiles.detailSubtitle: File metadata, moderation controls, and lifetime/daily analytics.
staffFiles.noModerationDecision: No moderation decision recorded yet; file is active.
staffFiles.restrictDescription: Restricting blocks new playback and download URLs and new saves of this file or folders containing it, including saved copies. App listings retain the record without media URLs or storage identifiers. Existing saves and storage usage remain attached. Previously issued URLs may remain valid until expiry.
staffFiles.restoreDescription: Restoring sets moderation status back to active and reopens playback, download, and save access under existing file and channel rules.
staffFiles.analyticsSavedOnlyNote: Per-file analytics are only available for existing original files. This record exists only as saved copies.
staffFiles.analyticsHint: Optional UTC date pair (from inclusive, to exclusive, maximum 90 days).
staffFiles.rangePairError: Provide both From and To dates to query a daily range, or clear both for lifetime totals only.
staffFiles.rangeOrderError: From date must be strictly earlier than To date.
staffFiles.byDayEmpty: No views or downloads recorded in this period.

staffFolders.title: Folders
staffFolders.subtitle: Browse user and channel folder hierarchies and inspect folder details.
staffFolders.detailSubtitle: Folder metadata, scope, parent resolution, and direct child counts.
staffFolders.name: Folder name
staffFolders.scopeDescription: Enter a User ID, a Channel ID, or both to list folders. Optionally narrow to root or a specific parent folder ID.
staffFolders.scopeRequiredError: Enter at least a User ID or a Channel ID.
staffFolders.invalidObjectId: Must be a valid 24-character hex ObjectId.
staffFolders.invalidParentId: Must be "root" or a valid 24-character hex ObjectId.
